install_steps: Download the hayabusa release zip for your platform from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases and extract the binary to PATH
note: Works on Linux/macOS/Windows — the target logs just need to be exported .evtx files, so it's ideal for analyzing logs collected from other machines. On Windows, `-l/--live-analysis` reads the local event log store directly. Detection rules auto-update via `hayabusa update-rules`.
